snippet.title: ❤️ গায়ের রং নয়, সুন্দর মনটাই আসল সৌন্দর্য! 🌸 | Islamic Story #Shorts
snippet.description:
🌸 গায়ের রং নয়, মানুষের আসল পরিচয় তার সুন্দর চরিত্রে! ❤️

মারিয়াম একজন সাধারণ মেয়ে। তার গায়ের রং গাঢ় হওয়ার কারণে নিজের বন্ধুদের কাছ থেকেই তাকে ঠাট্টা ও অবহেলার শিকার হতে হয়েছিল। বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠানে গিয়েও তাকে অপমানজনক আচরণের মুখোমুখি হতে হয়।

কিন্তু রিয়াদ সবার সামনে বুঝিয়ে দেয়—মানুষের সৌন্দর্য গায়ের রঙে নয়, তার মন, চরিত্র ও ভালো ব্যবহারে।

এই গল্প আমাদের শেখায়, কাউকে তার গায়ের রং, চেহারা কিংবা বাহ্যিক সৌন্দর্য দিয়ে বিচার করা উচিত নয়। প্রত্যেক মানুষ সম্মান পাওয়ার যোগ্য।

🕌 গল্পের মূল শিক্ষা:
মানুষের বাহ্যিক রূপ নয়, তার সুন্দর মন ও তাকওয়াই প্রকৃত মর্যাদার বিষয়।

🤲 আসুন, আমরা কাউকে ছোট না করি। সবাইকে সম্মান করি এবং সুন্দর আচরণ দিয়ে মানুষের মন জয় করি।

❤️ ভিডিওটি ভালো লাগলে:
👍 লাইক করবেন
💬 আপনার মূল্যবান মতামত কমেন্টে জানাবেন
📤 বন্ধু ও পরিবারের সঙ্গে শেয়ার করবেন
🔗 কপি লিংক করে ছড়িয়ে দেবেন
🔔 চ্যানেলটি সাবস্ক্রাইব করে বেল আইকন বাজিয়ে আমাদের পাশে থাকবেন।

আপনাদের ভালোবাসা ও সহযোগিতাই আমাদের অনুপ্রেরণা।

আল্লাহ আমাদের সবাইকে সুন্দর চরিত্রের অধিকারী করুন। আমিন। 🤲

snippet.title: SAN FRANCISCO HIT by Historic Flooding — 9-FT TIDES, Streets Submerged & More Storms Coming
snippet.description:
San Francisco is dealing with the aftermath of one of its most significant November rainstorms in more than a century. Streets were submerged, vehicles stranded, businesses flooded, and travel across the Bay Area was disrupted. The bigger concern now is what comes next.

Downtown San Francisco recorded 2.31 inches of rain on November 18, breaking a daily record set in 1918. The city's normal rainfall for all of November is about 2.6 inches, so nearly a full month of rain fell in a single day.

The flooding hit streets, garages and small businesses in several neighborhoods, from the Mission District and Haight-Ashbury to the Sunset District and Noriega Street. Roads were closed across the wider Bay Area, including an I-680 off-ramp in San Jose. PG&E reported 3,572 customers without power at 5:45 a.m. Thursday, SFO had a ground stop, ferry service was cancelled, and several Waymo vehicles were stranded in flooded streets.

King tides are expected to begin Sunday, November 22, with coastal water levels forecast 2 to 2.5 feet above the normal average high tide in vulnerable locations. Another storm system, with a possible atmospheric river, is expected Tuesday, November 24, with the heaviest rain forecast for Tuesday and Wednesday during the Thanksgiving travel period.

The footage in this video comes from social media and may not match the exact locations described. Figures come from the cited sources and are subject to change as conditions develop.

snippet.description:
Film 127 Hours (2010) menceritakan kisah nyata perjuangan bertahan hidup yang luar biasa dari Aron Ralston (James Franco), seorang pendaki gunung dan petualang berpengalaman. Cerita bermula ketika ia melakukan pendakian solo tanpa memberi tahu siapa pun di kawasan terpencil Bluejohn Canyon, Utah. Sebuah kecelakaan tak terduga terjadi saat sebongkah batu raksasa jatuh dan menjepit lengan kanannya ke dinding tebing secara permanen. Terjebak sendirian di dasar ngarai yang sempit tanpa sinyal telepon serta perbekalan air dan makanan yang sangat terbatas, Aron harus berjuang melawan dehidrasi, suhu dingin malam, dan halusinasi selama 127 jam atau lebih dari lima hari. Menyadari bahwa tim penyelamat tidak akan pernah menemukannya, ia akhirnya mengambil satu keputusan paling ekstrem dan menyakitkan dalam hidupnya demi bisa membebaskan diri dan bertahan hidup. Tonton alur lengkap kisah nyata paling menginspirasi dan menegangkan ini! 🏜️🧗‍♂️

Baby Leo became a doctor... then Henry tried to run away! 🩺😂 "Baby Doctor, stop!" Why is Henry so scared of a check-up? Watch this funny story and find out!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
It is a sunny afternoon. Baby Leo puts on a white doctor coat and a little doctor hat. He has a toy stethoscope and a box of bandages. "I am Doctor Leo!" he says. Big brother Henry is not happy. He is scared of doctors! "Baby Doctor, stop!" says Henry. Can Henry run away? Or will Leo's check-up be fun after all? Listen to the story to find out!

• doctor (n.) = a person who helps sick people
• check-up (n.) = a visit to see if you are healthy
• stethoscope (n.) = a tool doctors use to listen to your heart
• bandage (n.) = a soft cover for a small cut
• scared (adj.) = afraid
• brave (adj.) = not afraid
• run away (phrasal v.) = to go away fast
• stop (v.) = to not do something anymore
• toy (n.) = something children play with

snippet.title: Tornado Truck V7 vs a 300 MPH Tornado
snippet.description:
Version seven: designed in your comments, tested in an EF5, and for the first time it drives home.

The augers are helical anchors (screw piles): they are screwed into the ground with torque and come back out when you
turn them the other way, which is why V7 can leave and V6, held by anchors that lock under load, is still in the lawn.
Source: Pile Buck, "Instant removable helical foundations" (pilebuck.com).
About 300 mph is the fastest wind ever measured in a tornado: Doppler on Wheels, Bridge Creek-Moore, 3 May 1999, about
100 ft above the ground (Guinness World Records: 302 +/- 20 mph). A tornado's wind swings round as it passes, so a dome
has no flat side to catch it; it still gets suction at the top, which is why the augers hold it down.

This 3D animation is our own test, with the events exaggerated for fun; the anchors and the wind are real engineering.
The comment cards are real comments under V6, with their authors' handles.

snippet.title: "코로나 때보다 심각"..비만약 뜨자 줄줄이 문 닫는다 / SBS 8뉴스
snippet.description:
〈앵커〉

최근 헬스장 업계에 찬 바람이 불고 있습니다. "코로나 때보다 더 심각하다"는 아우성이 나올 정도입니다.

김민정 기자가 취재했습니다.

〈기자〉

30년째 헬스장 업계에서 일해 온 이규배 씨, 서울에서 3년 가까이 운영하던 330제곱미터 규모 헬스장이 올 들어 극심한 경영난에 빠졌습니다.

[이규배/FM피트니스 금호점 관장 : (몇 달 사이) 매출이 50프로 마이너스, 30프로 마이너스 그리고 또 50프로 마이너스….]

헬스장만 해선 안 될 처지가 됐습니다.

[이규배/FM피트니스 금호점 관장 : 투잡 쓰리잡, N잡을 하면서, 배달 쪽도 하고 뭐 일당도 뛰고….]

20년 경력의 강현구 씨도 불황을 피하지 못했습니다.

[강현구/지엘핏 쌍문본점 관장 : 벌어서 임대료라든지 관리비, 그다음에 직원분들 급여해서 나가고 나면 저는 진짜 지금 1원 한 푼도 못 가져가고 있는….]

고금리, 더딘 소비 회복으로 소비자들의 지갑이 좀처럼 열리지 않는 데다 위고비, 마운자로 같은 비만치료제의 인기까지, 헬스장 업계에 악재가 겹쳤습니다.

[이규배/FM피트니스 금호점 관장 : (해외에서 마운자로의) 휴대 반입을 허용한다는 그런 기사를 봤습니다. 저희들 입장에서는 너무나 힘든 상황인 거죠.]

러닝 크루 문화 확산도 큰 타격이 됐습니다.

[강현구/지엘핏 쌍문본점 관장 : PT를 지출하는 비용이 이제 너무 아까우니까 대체재를 찾으시다가 러닝을 찾게 되시는 거고.]

헬스장 관장들 대표 커뮤니티에 사업장을 내놓겠다는 글이 이달 들어서만 90건 넘게 쏟아지는 상황.

실제 올 들어 10월까지 헬스장 신규 개업 건수는 1,027건으로 지난해 같은 기간보다 25% 줄었고, 폐업은 500곳에서 710곳으로 늘었습니다.

이미 지난해 1년 동안 폐업 건수 649곳을 넘어선 겁니다.

헬스장 '줄폐업'이 현실화하면, 회원권 '먹튀 사태' 같은 소비자 피해로 돌아올 수 있다는 우려마저 나오고 있습니다.

(영상취재 : 전경배·김흥기·주용진, 영상편집 : 김종태)

snippet.title: "빈 봉투 거른다" 기계도 등장…'가짜 하객' 많아진 이유 / SBS 8뉴스
snippet.description:
〈앵커〉

요즘 예비부부가 하객인 것처럼 모르는 사람의 결혼식장을 둘러보고 음식도 먹어보는, 이른바 '암행 투어'가 많습니다. 이런 사람들 때문에 '축의금 봉투 투시 기계'까지 등장했습니다. 이 촌극 뒤엔 웨딩 업계의 고질적인 관행이 자리 잡고 있습니다.

이세현 기자가 현장을 취재했습니다.

〈기자〉

예식장에 하객인 척 참석해 식장을 둘러보고 음식도 먹어보는, 이른바 '웨딩홀 암행투어'.

SNS엔 '암행투어 10차례나 해봤다'거나 '2만 원만 내고 밥 먹었다' 등 관련 글도 많습니다.

빈 봉투를 내고 식권만 받아 가는 사람도 있다 보니, 이런 가짜 하객을 막겠다며 '봉투 투시 기계'까지 등장했습니다.

타인의 결혼식에 허락도 없이 견학처럼 참석하는 건 무례하다는 비판이 나옵니다.

[왕혜정·천형영/경기 부천시 : 나도 모르는 타인이 내 자리를 축하해주려고 온 게 아닌 그 사람의 목적과 이익을 달성하려고 오는 거면 조금 소름 끼칠 것 같긴 해요.] 

하지만 이런 지적에도 예비부부들이 암행투어에 나서는 이유는 비싼 예식비용에도 사전에 제대로 된 정보 얻기 힘든 예식장 문화 때문입니다.

[축의대 업체 대표 : (결혼식장) 예약하기 전에는 사실 시식하기가 참 어려워요.] 

웨딩 업체들이 몰려있는 서울 강남입니다.

저희 취재진들이 예비부부로 위장해서 직접 웨딩 상담을 한 번 받아보겠습니다.

취재진이 묻지도 않았는데 웨딩 플래너가 대뜸 암행투어 방법부터 설명합니다.

[웨딩 플래너 : 암행투어 얘기가 많잖아요. 그래도 어느 정도 격식 차린 자세로 옷을 입고 와주시면. 특히 (A식장)이나 (B식장)은 조금 제재가 있는 편….] 

결혼식장 사전 시식 등은 어렵고 당일 예약을 해야 할인이 된다는 설명도 나옵니다.

[웨딩 플래너 : 견적은 이렇게 되지만 여기는 당일 현장 계약 (할인)이 되게 커요.] 

결국 암행투어를 줄이려면 소비자원이 운영하는 공인 가격 사이트에 웨딩홀 실사용 후기 등 보다 구체적인 정보를 올릴 수 있게 하는 방안이 필요하다는 지적이 나옵니다.

[이은희/인하대 소비자학과 교수 : 객관적이고 정확한 정보를 소비자들이 많이 이용할 수 있게끔 유인하는 책으로 기프티콘이라든가 이런 거를 예산 잡아서….] 

또 전문가들은 계약 이후 추가 상품을 권유하고 할인 등을 내세워 즉시 결정을 요구하는 예식 서비스도 바뀌어야 한다고 조언합니다.
